picks.reasoning: LOS's recent form and CBLOL record look good, but that's a team-stat story and the crowd will chase it. T1's individual talent, Peyz and Keria especially, has beaten better regions on bigger stages, including the EWC final. I'm backing the players, not the 8-of-10 streak.

LOS owns the first 15: +0.8k GD, 45% first blood, 70% first towers, and T1 is running -0.8k with only 25% FB, so the tempo is on LOS's side. T1's comeback record is real, but I don't bet on a team digging out of an early hole when the jungle map control is already leaning the other way.

Under Fearless, LOS's deeper champion pool (Ryze, Orianna, Pantheon, Wukong) gives them more ways to reshape the draft, and their 9-of-10 recent form outweighs T1's LCK-level pedigree when T1 has gone 3-7 in its last ten. T1's 40% first tower and -0.8k GD@15 over their last 20 games suggest the early game is where they're vulnerable.

LOS has the better recent form (9-1 in its last 10 versus T1's 4-6), a +0.8k GD@15 against T1's -0.8k over the last 20 games, and a stronger 2026 game-level record. T1's pedigree, with the MSI and EWC results, keeps this close, so I'm only leaning modestly toward LOS.

LOS are riding a 9-of-10 wins wave and have the calm, connected feel of a group that trusts each other through comebacks, while T1 have looked heavy and unsure in their last ten, even with Keria's big-stage experience. I'd still respect T1's composure in a single game, so this is a lean, not a lock.
